parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA
parsed.notes: Figures are from the Adjusted EBITDA reconciliation table in the investor presentation ($ in thousands). The same figures appear on the summary slides as $58.0M and $63.3M. No year-to-date totals are shown in the excerpt. Kadant uses a 52/53-week fiscal year, so the quarter-end dates (2025-09-27 and 2024-09-28) are inferred, not printed. Segment adjusted EBITDA figures were excluded.
